defect: Both fixed-outline and automatic sizing caught every FloorplanError from the optional punch-free pass. That includes non-packing domain/calculation/observer errors, allowing a successful conservative result to hide an actual failure.
change: Catch only FloorplanPackingInfeasible at these two boundaries. Genuine packing-search rejection still retains the conservative incumbent and records punch_free_plan_rejected. Other errors propagate unchanged through the public failure-receipt transport.

tests.negative_control: New InjectedDomainFailure (a non-packing FloorplanError subtype) thrown after actual free-pass fallback work is swallowed by the original code; the instrumented regression fails. This was run before narrowing the catches.
tests.coverage: Fixed and auto outline paths: ordinary runtime failures and non-packing domain failures propagate; independent fallback entry/exit observations and direct/public receipts match exactly, including incoming prefixes. Typed packing rejection is handled, preserves the conservative result and complete accounting, executes one rejected free-pass attempt, and does not produce a terminal failure receipt.

scope: All reference construction screens pass placement-contract/flow diagnostics and have zero hard-red constraints. Successful-path output parity and targeted failure-path tests, not a new full board qualification, speed comparison, or hardware readiness claim. No fallback ceiling or other acceptance gate changed. The experimental 165x159 candidate remains unaccepted.
